note: Each finding records the source it measures, the input actually supplied, the observed output, the invariant it violates, its evidence class, and what remains uncertain. A `not_reproduced` finding is a measured negative, not a skipped test.

findings.title: An existing destination junction is invisible to existsSync, so the fallback can write through it
findings.hypothesis: `existsSync` reports a dangling junction as unoccupied even though `lstat` shows a reparse point, so occupancy is decided on a false premise.
findings.invariant: A destination that is a reparse object must never be treated as free.

thrown.message: ENOENT, The system cannot find the file specified. 'F:\s1ra-ra0-5xv7fd\home-3-f1-dangling\profiles\node_modules\pkg-alpha'

findings.uncertainty: Measured: the helper aborts with ENOENT instead of reporting MODULE_SHARING_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Whether a copy would have written through the link is therefore not observable in this arm, because the copy never ran.

findings.title: A partially installed graph is completed by a dereferencing copy
findings.hypothesis: A failed junction install silently degrades into a full dereferencing copy over a partially populated graph.
findings.invariant: A partial install must fail closed with an explicit MODULE_SHARING_NOT_ESTABLISHED result, not be completed by a copy into an unverified destination.

thrown.message: ENOENT, The system cannot find the file specified. 'F:\s1ra-ra0-5xv7fd\home-5-f2-dangling-occupant\profiles\node_modules\pkg-beta'

findings.uncertainty: The ordinary-file arm is the narrower case: the occupant survives, but the returned strategy claims a copy succeeded while an entry is missing, so a caller cannot tell an incomplete graph from a complete one.

findings.title: Cleanup deletes from CACHED ownership flags and never re-validates the path identity
findings.hypothesis: Deletion trusts the containment flag cached at allocation, so a path replaced after allocation is still deleted.
findings.invariant: Ownership must be re-proved at deletion time against the identity recorded at allocation; a replaced path must be preserved.
findings.uncertainty: Arm (b) shows the junction case is NOT destructive on this platform: `rmSync` removed the link and left the target byte-identical. The defect is the missing identity re-check, which arm (a) demonstrates.

findings.title: A failed cleanup cannot be retried, and the failure is not distinguishable from success by the caller
findings.hypothesis: One failed deletion permanently marks the root disposed, so a later safe retry is impossible.
findings.invariant: A failed cleanup must stay retryable while ownership holds, must report the original reason, and must never be reported as success.

firstDispose.reason: preserved after retries: EPERM, Permission denied: 'F:\s1ra-ra0-5xv7fd\gate-root\ra0-f4-locked-fH0Pbf'

secondDispose.reason: preserved after retries: EPERM, Permission denied: 'F:\s1ra-ra0-5xv7fd\gate-root\ra0-f4-locked-fH0Pbf'

thirdDisposeAfterLockReleased.reason: preserved after retries: EPERM, Permission denied: 'F:\s1ra-ra0-5xv7fd\gate-root\ra0-f4-locked-fH0Pbf'

findings.uncertainty: The lock is a process CWD, which is one of several Windows handle kinds; other lock kinds were not enumerated.

findings.title: Signal listeners installed by the lifetime helper are never removed
findings.hypothesis: `dispose()` leaves the SIGINT and SIGTERM listeners registered, so they accumulate and stay able to exit the process.
findings.invariant: Explicit disposal must remove every listener the helper installed.
findings.uncertainty: Listener accumulation is measured; the consequence of a stale handler calling process.exit was not exercised on a live gate.

findings.title: The reaper selects by name prefix and modification time, not by proven ownership
findings.hypothesis: Prefix plus age is sufficient for the reaper to select a directory it does not own.
findings.invariant: A candidate without a verifiable ownership record must be preserved; age alone cannot establish ownership.
findings.uncertainty: Report-only. The consequence of `--apply` was not exercised against the real gate root, per §5.5.

findings.title: The storage suite passes when its module import fails
findings.hypothesis: A suite whose module import fails reports success because every control asserts only that an error message exists.
findings.invariant: A test whose module could not be imported must fail or remain explicitly unestablished; it must not count as PASS.
findings.uncertainty: The reproduction used a copy of the suite with one constant changed; the shipped file is unmodified by this arm.

findings.title: Two identifiers that render identically name different environment variables
findings.hypothesis: The test manipulates one variable name while the implementation reads another. MEASURED: two distinct identifiers render identically and differ in their first code point.
findings.invariant: A test must configure the value the module actually reads.
findings.uncertainty: The collision is established from the files' own bytes and from the observed resolution. Whether the PRODUCTION variable is set correctly in a real deployment was not measured here.

findings.title: The evidence generator performs destructive worktree operations on a fixed path
findings.hypothesis: The generator prepares a parent checkout with destructive operations on a fixed, unowned path.
findings.invariant: A qualification run must not mutate shared Git administrative state or delete a path whose ownership it did not record.

operations.affects: the rig directory; also any pre-existing directory at that path, whoever created it
operations.ownershipCheck: none — the path is derived from the rig, not from a recorded allocation

operations.affects: ALL stale worktree registrations, including ones belonging to other checkouts and other runs
the worktree registry; `-f` bypasses a conflict that would otherwise be reported

operations.path: a junction into the repository's installed modules
operations.affects: creates a path from a disposable checkout into the shared install
operations.ownershipCheck: the link is verified to be absent before creation, but its target is not re-verified afterwards

operations.path: a checkout of a DIFFERENT commit
operations.affects: the worktree no longer matches the commit it claims to be detached at

findings.sourceCommentClaim: `rmSync(..., { recursive: true })` on a directory that CONTAINS a junction FOLLOWS it on this platform
findings.uncertainty: The operations were classified from source and NOT executed against this repository. The platform claim was measured in a synthetic repository, so it carries no risk to the real one.

findings.title: Host-S1 historical evidence was overwritten and Host-S1R artifacts were placed inside it
findings.hypothesis: A later stage wrote into the historical Host-S1 evidence directory, overwriting two files and adding six.
findings.invariant: A stage's generator must write only to its own evidence directory, and historical evidence must stay byte-identical.
findings.uncertainty: Blob identity proves the content changed; which stage wrote each blob was established from the commit history, not from the blobs themselves.

findings.title: The Host-S1R qualification evidence is bound to a Code Freeze that predates current HEAD
findings.hypothesis: The evidence's declared Code Freeze is not the current HEAD, so the executable changes after it are unqualified.
findings.invariant: A success claim must identify the code it actually measured; executable changes after the freeze require requalification.
findings.uncertainty: This establishes the binding gap, not that any specific verdict is wrong — the gap is what requires requalification.

findings.title: The real runtime home is a junction whose target protection is not established by the junction's own label
findings.hypothesis: The configured runtime home is a junction, and a label on the link is not a label on the target's contents.
findings.invariant: A confidentiality claim about the runtime home must name which object carries the protection.

D:\dsh BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)

       NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)

       NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)
       NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(OI)(CI)(IO)(M)
